title: Life insurers thrive on group cover in Oct as retail APE lags
summary: Life insurance firms in India experienced a noteworthy 26% rise in new business premiums year-over-year for October, thanks mainly to robust group insurance growth. On the other hand, retail annualised premium equivalent only saw a modest uptick of 5.2%, while individual policy sales declined by 3.7%. This scenario points to retail sector hurdles, although the increasing popularity of protection products could signal potential for future expansion.

title: Blackstone lines up $200 million loan to refinance ASK credit line
summary: Blackstone is in the process of arranging a $200 million loan for ASK Investment Managers. This loan aims to refinance an existing sponsor-financing facility that matures in 2027. Four banks are leading this transaction, which is currently being syndicated among international lenders. The refinancing effort reflects private equity investors' strategy to manage acquisition-related debt maturities.

title: Sensex, Nifty mark 2-week winning run on FPI inflows
summary: Indian equity benchmarks in Mumbai have seen a two-week winning streak with significant foreign investment. Foreign Portfolio Investors have invested over ₹75,000 crore in November, while domestic institutional investors have sold shares worth around ₹46,835 crore. The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty both experienced mild increases despite profit booking by domestic investors. Brent crude oil prices have declined, contributing positively to India's macroeconomic outlook.

title: These large-, mid- and small-cap stocks have upside potential of more than 20% in 1 year, according to analysts
summary: The probability of a sharp, damaging downturn now appears low, and the broad direction favours the market. So, the stance should be the same as in these past few weeks: Shedding fear, but cautiously optimistic. Focus on the business under the stock you are interested in, and keep one eye on what is happening globally.

title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
summary: Indian equities ended marginally higher as profit booking pared early gains, while small- and micro-cap stocks outperformed largecaps. Analysts attribute the broader market resilience to sustained domestic investor participation and buying interest beyond frontline stocks.

title: Stocks in news: Vodafone Idea, M&M, Ola Electric, IRCTC, Oil India and Zee Entertainment
summary: The Nifty ended marginally higher on Thursday, with analysts identifying 25,000–25,150 as the immediate support zone and 25,400–25,500 as resistance. Meanwhile, Vodafone Idea, M&M, Ola Electric, IRCTC, Oil India and Zee Entertainment are among the stocks likely to remain in focus on Friday amid earnings and company-specific developments.

title: DIIs book profits in longest selling streak in 4 years
summary: Domestic institutional investors have recently unloaded more than ₹47,662 crore worth of equities amidst a market upswing. This shift showcases their tendency to lock in profits following substantial input into Indian stocks. Conversely, foreign portfolio investors have returned vigorously, investing about $8 billion since mid-October. This marks a notable change in market behavior, as local investors experience their longest selling streak in four years.

title: MSCI adds LIC, Coforge, Adani Green and Meesho to Emerging Markets Index
summary: MSCI will include Life Insurance Corporation of India, Coforge, Adani Green Energy, and Meesho in its index. The changes will take effect on November 30, with passive inflows expected for these new additions. PI Industries will be excluded, leading to an estimate of outflows from this stock. Additionally, the overall number of constituents will increase to 168 in the index.

title: Stock Radar: Adani Power stock showing signs of recovery after falling 18% from highs; what should investors do?
summary: Adani Power Ltd has rebounded after testing key support levels, which indicates a positive trend. Analysts suggest that short-term traders could buy the stock with a target of Rs 245. The stock recently experienced a significant decline but remains within an ascending channel. Technical indicators support a bullish outlook for the stock's trajectory moving forward. This analysis highlights potential volatility and the importance of maintaining trend support.

title: Smaller MFIs change tack: No onlending, just routing funds
summary: India’s microfinance sector is seeing a structural shift as funding constraints and mounting stress push smaller lenders away from direct lending towards business correspondent models. With bank funding and fresh equity drying up, lenders are increasingly pursuing off-balance-sheet growth and earning fee income by acting as agents for banks. Industry leaders say the traditional joint-liability group lending model is losing relevance as borrowers gain access to multiple formal and digital credit options.

summary: Newton Commercial Finance, a joint venture between Apple Bank and Eagle Point Credit Management, is in early talks with investors about a potential $180 million bond offering partly backed by artificial intelligence chip loans.

summary: The yen slid to the verge of 160 to the dollar, a key threshold that’s raising the specter that policymakers in Tokyo will swoop in again to defend the currency.

title: The Yen Is Becoming Too Hard for Some Investors to Trade
summary: After a year of wild swings, the yen surprised traders by settling into a tight range clustered near 158 per dollar over recent months. But on Wednesday it broke out again, unexpectedly weakening toward 160.

title: Anthropic’s IPO Is About Six Times Oversubscribed
summary: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering has drawn about six times the orders for the shares available, according to people familiar with the matter, as interest increases for potentially the biggest first-time share sale ever.

title: Trafigura Is Key Player in LME Aluminum Squeeze With China Trade
summary: Trafigura Group has bought up significant volumes of aluminum on the London Metal Exchange, making it a key player in a historic squeeze as inventories of the metal plunge.

title: Microsoft outage drags on for five hours, disrupting Outlook, Teams and Copilot for thousands across US
summary: Microsoft faced a major outage on Thursday, disrupting access to Outlook, Teams and Copilot for several hours. The disruption also affected connectors used by OpenAI and Anthropic, while the company worked to restore affected servers and gradually bring services back online.
